correctness.rationale: The 5-ary column-word model is bijective with all faces; independent direct enumeration of 5^7=78125 words recovered f-vector (1,28,315,1820,5670,9240,6930,1680), total 25684 including empty and reduced Euler characteristic -148. The inspected full checker.py specifies a deterministic lower/upper toggle matching, traverses all 128338 Hasse cover relations, and checks full directed acyclicity on the face set, not samples; its unmatched ordinary Morse cells are one 0-cell plus 2 dimensions-3,124 dimensions-4,270 dimensions-5 cells. Its signed integral Morse differentials D4: Z^124→Z^2 and D5: Z^270→Z^124 satisfy D4D5=0 with Smith diagonal 1×2 and 1×122, respectively. Primitive images and equal ranks imply H4=0 and H5=Z^(270-122)=Z^148 without torsion; no 1- or 2-cells and the vanishing lower homology yield 4-connectivity by Hurewicz. A wedge of 148 S5 maps by a basis in π5 and homological Whitehead gives the claimed homotopy type. I inspected the exact integer Smith algorithm rather than equating a mod-p result with integral topology.
